class User(StructuredNode):
    """Model User (table user)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "AUTHOR", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    edited_posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "EDITOR", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    profile = RelationshipFrom("Profile", "USER", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)


class Category(StructuredNode):
    """Model Category (table category)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    name = StringProperty(max_length=100, unique_index=True, required=True)
    slug = StringProperty(max_length=50, required=True)
    parent_id = StringProperty(db_property="parentId")
    parent = RelationshipTo("Category", "PARENT", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
    children = RelationshipFrom("Category", "PARENT", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)
    posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "CATEGORY", cardinality=ZeroOrMore)


class Post(StructuredNode):
    """Model Post (table post)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    public_id = StringProperty(
        unique_index=True,
        default=lambda: str(uuid4()),
        db_property="publicId",
    )
    title = StringProperty(max_length=200, index=True, required=True)
    body = StringProperty(required=True)
    status = StringProperty(
        choices={"draft": "DRAFT", "published": "PUBLISHED"},
        index=True,
        default="draft",
    )
    rating = StringProperty()
    view_count = IntegerProperty(default=0, db_property="viewCount")
    is_featured = BooleanProperty(default=False, db_property="isFeatured")
    published_at = DateTimeProperty(
        default_now=True,
        index=True,
        db_property="publishedAt",
    )
    metadata = JSONProperty(required=True)
    author_id = StringProperty(index=True, required=True, db_property="authorId")
    editor_id = StringProperty(db_property="editorId")
    category_id = StringProperty(required=True, db_property="categoryId")
    author = RelationshipTo("User", "AUTHOR", cardinality=One)
    editor = RelationshipTo("User", "EDITOR", cardinality=ZeroOrOne)
    category = RelationshipTo("Category", "CATEGORY", cardinality=One)
    tags = RelationshipTo("Tag", "TAGS", cardinality=ZeroOrMore, model=PostTagRel)


class Tag(StructuredNode):
    """Model Tag (table tag)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    label = StringProperty(max_length=50, required=True)
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
    posts = RelationshipFrom("Post", "TAGS", cardinality=ZeroOrMore, model=PostTagRel)


class Profile(StructuredNode):
    """Model Profile (table profile)."""

    id_ = UniqueIdProperty(db_property="id")
    bio = StringProperty()
    avatar = StringProperty(max_length=100)
    created_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="createdAt")
    updated_at = DateTimeProperty(default_now=True, db_property="updatedAt")
